newsitem.title: USA: Alrenco buys 12 stores, to purchase more.
newsitem.headline: Alrenco buys 12 stores, to purchase more.

text.p: Alrenco Inc said Thursday it acquired 12 rental-purchase stores in three separate transactions and signed letters of intent to buy two additional stores.
Terms of the transactions were not disclosed.
The stores have combined annualized revenues of $7.7 million. Alrenco said it expects them to be moderately accretive to 1997 results.

"In keeping with our growth strategies, we will continue to explore and analyze any attractive opportunities that are presented to us," Alrenco Chairman and President Michael Walts said in a statement.
Nine stores were acquired from Monterey TV Center Inc and are in Florida, North Carolina and South Carolina. Also included in the purchase was Monterey's South Florida service center.
Three stores were purchased in existing Alrenco markets -- two in Texas from Whitaker Partners Ltd and one in Virginia.
Letters of intent were signed to acquire two stores in Dallas, Texas, and the transactions are expected to close within the month, the company said.
